payload.title: Derive arithmetic operator type constraints from source context without coercion
payload.work_clay: Assign symbolic result types to open expressions, propagate only source-declared/context-forced type equalities, and report each current arithmetic operator application as LHS x RHS -> result without selecting operator semantics.
payload.reason_clay: Arithmetic inventory and scalar-contract census proved that real arithmetic is cross-nominal and that Epoch, Score and Confidence have no explicit scalar aliases. The next question is whether current program contexts themselves determine concrete operator signatures before any new language contract is introduced.
payload.completion_clay: Complete when target PR-merge-context evidence reports concrete versus symbolic operator signatures, preserves source type conflicts as evidence, selects no operator/coercion/type alias, and makes instrumentation failures distinguishable from semantic counterexamples.
payload.executor_policy: Diagnostic only. Preserve nominal dimensions and UNKNOWN. Do not use C/Python coercion as type evidence.
invalidators: new canonical typed signature surface materially closes symbolic constraints
